paragraphs: Zeiri evaded Rabbi Yochanan, who told him,“Marry my daughter.” He did not wish to, because she was of the Land of Israel and he of Babylonia. One day they traveled and reached a water-channel; he carried Yochanan on his shoulders across it. He told him,“Our Torah is fit”—you are my student and my Torah is fit—“but our daughters are not?” You do not want my daughter: Kiddushin 71b. Yuchasin writes that he learned from Rav and was well-born from Babylonia, and did not wish to marry Yochanan’s daughter, in Taanit. I do not know why he was not called Rav. Resh Lakish spoke with him, though he would not speak with Rabbah bar bar Chana: Yoma 9, end of side b. How did Yuchasin know that Zeiri studied with Rav, and which Rav did Zeiri study with? See below: it appears he did not learn from Rav. The refusal of Yochanan’s daughter is not found in Taanit. Zeiri said,“You who have not seen the Italian issar”: Chullin 54b. Zeiri said a weasel injury cannot be examined. When he went up from Babylonia to Nehardea, he sent,“The things I told you were mistaken in my hands; rather, thus they said in Resh Lakish’s name”: there 56a. In Zeiri’s notebook:“I said before my teacher”—who is that? Rabbi Chiyya—Shabbat 156a. Rava said,“Any baraita Rav Zeiri has not explained remains unexplained”: Zevachim 43b. The word Rav appears a scribal error, for he is nowhere called Rav Zeiri. Abba son of Rav Chisda said in Zeiri’s name. When Rabbi Elazar went up he found Zeiri and asked who in the Land recited the mishnayot and baraitot on measures that Rav had taught. He showed him Rav Yitzchak bar Avdimi: Bava Batra 87, end of side a. Chullin 110a: who taught Rav about udder …. This somewhat suggests Zeiri did not learn from Rav. When Rabbi Zeira went up, he found Ammi stating this teaching—Zeiri’s, Rashi—Chullin 21, beginning of side a. Rav Dimi said in Zeiri’s name. Under the letter He, Yuchasin writes Rav Huna was Zeiri’s student, because Huna reported Zeiri. I did not find it; perhaps it should read Zeira (see his entry). Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi was his student. Zeiri reported Rabbi Chanina: Shabbat 17a, 50a; Eruvin 67a, 63a; Ketubbot 15a; Menachot 21a, 30b. Rav Chisda said in Zeiri’s name: Berakhot 43a; Avodah Zarah 49b, 60b. The earlier Rav Chisda bar Ashi was his student; requires examination. Rav Yehudah reported Zeiri: Avodah Zarah 61b; Menachot 21a. Zeiri reported Rabbi Yochanan (see above). Rav Yosef said in Zeiri’s name: Nedarim 46b. Rav Yitzchak son of Rabbah bar bar Chana (see his entry). Zeiri reported Rav Kahana: end of Hazahav. Rav Nachman reported Zeiri: Avodah Zarah 61b. Surchav bar Pappa in his name. Rava said in Zeiri’s name: Sotah 5, beginning of side a. Rabbah said in Zeiri’s name: Nedarim 46, end of side a. [Glosses: Zeiri. A) Zevachim 43b: Rav Zeiri; everywhere it mentions Zeiri. L. T. B) Arakhin 14, end of side b, and 33a: Rav Zeira; he is called only Zeira or Rabbi Zeira. Not corrected.]
